description: Corpus-distilled Russian dissertation writing intelligence platform. Historical v5.4.1 build from 2,118 source documents, with 679 deep analyses.

retrieval.matching: Category filter and keyword overlap. Cluster results use record labels; a nonempty query with no lexical matches returns an empty array.

statistics_scope.basis: Historical v5.4.1 build manifest; not a live inventory of this installation.
statistics_scope.templates: Build records by DIS, AREF and UTILS. Shards, masters and aggregates overlap; filesystem rows, unique text and runtime-visible templates are different measures.
statistics_scope.sources: Build input documents; DIS and AREF may belong to the same thesis. Independent works and verified PDF links require the authoritative private index.
statistics_scope.layers: Historical build figures. Local discipline JSONL files are optional and may differ from the release checkout.
